ننبثق (form VII)
# نَنْبَثِقُ (nanbaṯiqu) /nan.ba.θi.qu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِنْبَثَقَ (inbaṯaqa)
# نَنْبَثِقَ (nanbaṯiqa) /nan.ba.θi.qa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِنْبَثَقَ (inbaṯaqa)
# نَنْبَثِقْ (nanbaṯiq) /nan.ba.θiq/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِنْبَثَقَ (inbaṯaqa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
